gunnison.linePrev: Well, when the wind don't blow in Amarillo
gunnison.line: And the moon along the Gunnison don't rise
gunnison.lineNext: Shall I cast my dreams upon your love, babe?
stanza: Well, when the wind don't blow in Amarillo
And the moon along the Gunnison don't rise
Shall I cast my dreams upon your love, babe?
And lie beneath the laughter of your eyes
